_about: Parts to build from, not a menu. Step 2 designs each point's animation from its material first (references/research.md: what is special about the material, and an idea of the film's own, with a sketch); one of these is an idea only when it is the best way to show that point, or the start of the film's own. Each one: what it fits (the user reads this), what it needs, a film that used it, a preview strip cut from that film (beats/previews/<id>.jpg) and how it goes into film.json. group: opening, middle or ending (a film is one opening, a few middles, one ending; the opening is chosen by the story: it hands over to the first point). kind: story (a piece of the template's story) or beat (beats/<id>.js, its own clock).

label.zh-Hant: 開場：主頁浮喺半空，頭像好似貼紙咁撕起，變成公仔
label.zh-Hans: 开场：主页浮在半空，头像像贴纸一样撕起来，变成公仔
label.en: Opening: the page floats in the air; the picture peels off like a sticker and becomes the toy

fits.zh-Hant: 佢嘅主頁浮喺半空，頭像好似貼紙咁撕起，彈出變公仔
fits.zh-Hans: 主页浮在半空，头像像贴纸一样撕起，弹出变公仔
fits.en: Their page floats as glass; the picture peels off like a sticker and pops into the toy

animations.needs: the profile page and picture (always there)

label.zh-Hant: 開場：主頁好似螢幕咁平放，向右轉身企起，頭像鼓起變成公仔
label.zh-Hans: 开场：主页像屏幕一样平放，向右转身立起，头像鼓起变成公仔
label.en: Opening: the page lies flat like a screen, turns right and stands up; the picture puffs out into the toy

fits.zh-Hant: 主頁好似螢幕咁平放，轉身拆開做企起嘅板，頭像鼓起變公仔
fits.zh-Hans: 主页像屏幕一样平放，转身拆开成立起的板，头像鼓起变公仔
fits.en: The page lies flat like a screen, turns and parts into standing slabs; the picture puffs out into the toy

label.zh-Hant: 開場：主頁好似螢幕咁平放，向左轉身企起，頭像鼓起變成公仔
label.zh-Hans: 开场：主页像屏幕一样平放，向左转身立起，头像鼓起变成公仔
label.en: Opening: the page lies flat like a screen, turns left and stands up; the picture puffs out into the toy

fits.zh-Hant: 主頁好似螢幕咁平放，轉身拆開做企起嘅板，頭像鼓起變公仔
fits.zh-Hans: 主页像屏幕一样平放，转身拆开成立起的板，头像鼓起变公仔
fits.en: The page lies flat like a screen, turns and parts into standing slabs; the picture puffs out into the toy

label.zh-Hant: 呢條片自己嘅動畫：由佢嘅素材出發設計
label.zh-Hans: 这条片自己的动画：从创作者的素材出发设计
label.en: The film's own animation, designed from their material

fits.zh-Hant: 每一點都先由佢嘅素材諗：素材有乜特別（數量、規模、前後對比、佢自己嘅風格同字體、本身已經識郁嘅嘢），動畫就用嗰樣。例如一年嘅每日一畫翻成一段動畫
fits.zh-Hans: 每一点都先从创作者的素材想：素材有什么特别（数量、规模、前后对比、自己的风格和字体、本身会动的东西），动画就用那一样。例如一年的每日一画翻成一段动画
fits.en: Every point starts from its material: what is special about it (its quantity, scale, a before and after, their own style and type, a motion it already has), and the animation uses that. Say, a year of daily drawings flipped into one animation

animations.needs: the material, its sketch on the story page, and a beat written in the film (references/beats.md, "A beat of your own"; the kit's picture cards and layouts)
animations.example: cgnot996: the ambassador invitation (its own beat)

label.en: The number rises from the page

fits.zh-Hant: 一篇帖嘅大數字（閱讀、播放、讚好），由頁面上原本嗰個位升起跳數；置頂帖最好
fits.zh-Hans: 一篇帖子的大数字（阅读、播放、点赞），从页面上原来的位置升起跳数；置顶帖最好
fits.en: A post's big number (views, plays, likes) rises from its own spot on the page and counts up; a pinned post is best

animations.needs: a post on the page with a number, written the platform's way (304万 阅读, 6.5万 看过, 7,253 查看, 46K views)

fits.zh-Hant: 一篇帖嘅封面企起做 3D 牆，大字逐件推出嚟，公仔爬上去：封面要有大字，仲要有位爬（一級矮台加三級錯開嘅盒，每級上面有公仔咁高嘅空位）
fits.zh-Hans: 一篇帖的封面立起来变 3D 墙，大字逐件推出来，公仔爬上去：封面要有大字，还要有位置爬（一级矮台加三级错开的盒子，每级上方留出公仔那么高的空位）
fits.en: A post's cover stands up as a 3D wall, its big words pushing out piece by piece; the toy climbs it. The cover needs big lettering and room to climb: a low ledge and three boxes stepping up across it, each with the toy's height of clear space above

animations.needs: a post whose cover has big lettering and up to three claims or numbers to climb (pieces cut from it: references/cover-wall.md). Not for illustrations, photos or small text: pick another animation, or write one
animations.example: isnail: 自媒体很苦 / 46K粉, 12–24 s; cgnot996: 5天 380+ star

fits.zh-Hant: 任何一個數字：粉絲里程碑、star、播放、日數。數字喺佢自己嘅舞台跳升、鎖定，公仔跳起慶祝
fits.zh-Hans: 任何一个数字：粉丝里程碑、star、播放、天数。数字在自己的舞台上跳升、锁定，公仔跳起庆祝
fits.en: Any number: a follower milestone, stars, plays, days. It counts up on its own stage and locks; the toy jumps for joy

animations.needs: the number and its label, written the platform's way (10,000 关注者, 1,500 star)

fits.zh-Hant: 冇圖都得嘅想法：由某日到某日做到某件事。日曆越翻越快，數字跟住升，停低蓋印
fits.zh-Hans: 没有图也行的想法：从某天到某天做到某件事。日历越翻越快，数字跟着升，停下盖章
fits.en: An idea with no picture: from one day to another they got somewhere. The pages fly faster, a count climbs beside them, a stamp lands

animations.needs: two dates; optionally a count and a stamp of one or two words
animations.example: cgnot996: 7月10日 → 10月24日, 10,000 关注者, 万粉

fits.zh-Hant: 佢嘅原話：自我介紹嗰句、金句、一篇帖嘅標題。字逐個由地下彈出，最後一個字落喺重拍
fits.zh-Hans: 创作者的原话：自我介绍那句、金句、一篇帖子的标题。字逐个从地下弹出，最后一个字落在重拍
fits.en: Their own words: a bio line, a quote, a post's title. It rises a letter at a time, the last on a downbeat

animations.needs: the line, short (a 3-bar beat holds about nine characters)
animations.example: cgnot996: 马斯克得不到的男人

label.en: The end card: name and line

fits.zh-Hant: 佢個名、帳號同一句口號貼喺撕紙上，公仔坐喺一件代表佢嘅道具上面
fits.zh-Hans: 创作者的名字、账号和一句口号贴在撕纸上，公仔坐在一件代表创作者的道具上
fits.en: Their name, handle and a line slap down on torn paper; the toy rides a prop that stands for them

animations.needs: the line (one or two short parts) and the prop (references/props.md)
animations.example: isnail: 公众号变现 / 找蜗牛, the snail
